column1: # The Phase 8 record -- every question Forge can put to a player, and every
# cost kind it can ask to have paid (PHASE_08_EVERY_FORGE_QUESTION_LOCKED.md).
# One row per entry of Forge's PlayerController and cost visitor at the
# pinned version. The ENTRIES are not chosen by hand: ForgeQuestionRecordTest
# reads them from the compiled code and fails the build when a row is
# missing, extra, or claims something the code does not do. Only the words
# and the evidence are written by hand, and a status changes only with its
#   entry     Q method(Param,Types) or C CostKind, exactly as reflected
#   status    ASKS / TELLS / ENGINE / UNBUILT / UNREACHABLE / ROUTES-TO /
#   asks      for ASKS: the question name(s) the page receives -- each must
#             be asked in that CI run's Mechanics Lab games
#   evidence  the scenario(s) that reach it, LoudFailureTest for a loud
#             stop, "-> entry" for ROUTES-TO, "-" for a property, or
#             "PENDING: why" while its proof is still to come (P8-E closes
#             these; the exit gate allows none). scripts/check-question-record.py
#             holds every piece of evidence to existing and running in CI.
